rows.statement:
theorem sysstep_preserves_existing_origin (p : Params) (env : Env)
    {s s' : Sys} (hs : SysStep p env s s') (aid : AID) (origin : Origin)
    (ho : s.origins aid = some origin) : s'.origins aid = some origin
rows.sourceStory:
Given any actual system step and an already stored origin, when observing that
AID afterward, the entire origin is unchanged, including fixed Registry
Params/Env/Config, exact registration snapshot, alias and output references.
Registration can install an origin only into an absent/unbound AID. Local,
booking and completion events preserve existing origins; completion clears
only the pending association. This binds all later history extensions to the
origin context rather than reselecting one at each event.

story.given:
(p : Params) (env : Env)
    {s s' : Sys} (hs : SysStep p env s s') (aid : AID) (origin : Origin)
    (ho : s.origins aid = some origin)
story.when: Observe the local Checkpoint or associated system relation named by this theorem.
story.then: s'.origins aid = some origin

rows.statement:
theorem parse_head (fuel m n : Nat) (t : List Nat) (hm : m < 7) (hn : n < 18446744073709551616) :
    parse (fuel + 1) (head m n ++ t) =
      if m = 0 then some (.int n, t)
      else if m = 1 then some (.int (Int.negSucc n), t)
      else if m = 2 then (if n ≤ t.length then some (.bytes (t.take n), t.drop n) else none)
      else if m = 4 then (parseCount fuel n t).map fun p => (.list p.1, p.2)
      else if m = 5 then (parseEntries fuel n t).map fun p => (.map p.1, p.2)
      else if m = 6 then
        if n = 2 then (readBstr t).map fun p => (.int (beVal p.1), p.2)
        else if n = 3 then (readBstr t).map fun p => (.int (Int.negSucc (beVal p.1)), p.2)
        else if 121 ≤ n ∧ n < 128 then
          match parse fuel t with
          | some (.list fs, r') => some (.constr (n - 121) fs, r')
          | _ => none
        else if 1280 ≤ n ∧ n < 1401 then
          match parse fuel t with
          | some (.list fs, r') => some (.constr (n - 1280 + 7) fs, r')
          | _ => none
        else if n = 102 then
          match parse fuel t with
          | some (.list [.int (.ofNat i), .list fs], r') => some (.constr i fs, r')
          | _ => none
        else none
      else none
rows.sourceStory:
Given a CBOR head of major type `m` below 7 and argument below 2^64, and any rest; when read
by one step of the item reader; then the reader dispatches on that major type and argument.

story.when: Observe the local Checkpoint or associated system relation named by this theorem.

rows.statement:
theorem mapM_some_inverse {α β : Type} {f : α → Option β} {g : β → α}
    (h : ∀ a b, f a = some b → a = g b) :
    ∀ (as : List α) (bs : List β), as.mapM f = some bs → as = bs.map g
  | [], bs, hm => by simp at hm; subst hm; rfl
  | a :: as, bs, hm => by
    simp only [List.mapM_cons, bind, Option.bind_eq_some_iff, pure, Option.some.injEq] at hm
    obtain ⟨b, hb, bs', hbs, rfl⟩
rows.sourceStory: Given a reader whose every success reads back what a writer writes; when it reads a whole list successfully; then the list is the writer's output of the result.

story.then:
∀ (as : List α) (bs : List β), as.mapM f = some bs → as = bs.map g
  | [], bs, hm => by simp at hm; subst hm; rfl
  | a :: as, bs, hm => by

rows.sourceStory:
**T1d.** No step decreases the sequence a state records, across every
state that records one: pending termination records the convicted
checkpoint's own sequence. Completed retirement records no sequence.

story.given:
(p : Params) (env : Env) {a : Action} {t : Slot} {s s' : State} {f : Flow}
    (h : Step p env a t s f s') (n n' : Seq) (hn : s.sn? = some n) (hn' : s'.sn? = some n')
story.when: Observe the local Checkpoint or associated system relation named by this theorem.
story.then: n ≤ n'

rows.sourceStory:
Along any trace, the sequence recorded never decreases between states
that record one, pending termination included.

story.given:
(p : Params) (env : Env) {t : Slot} {s s' : State}
    {es : List (Slot × Action)} (h : Trace p env t s es s')
story.when: Observe the local Checkpoint or associated system relation named by this theorem.
story.then: ∀ n n', s.sn? = some n → s'.sn? = some n' → n ≤ n'

rows.statement:
theorem T1_trace_sn_monotone (p : Params) (env : Env) {t : Slot} {l l' : Live}
    {es : List (Slot × Action)} (h : Trace p env t (.present l) es (.present l')) : l.sn ≤ l'.sn
rows.sourceStory:
**T1c.** Along any trace between present states the sequence never
decreases.

story.given:
(p : Params) (env : Env) {t : Slot} {l l' : Live}
    {es : List (Slot × Action)} (h : Trace p env t (.present l) es (.present l'))
story.when: Observe the local Checkpoint or associated system relation named by this theorem.
story.then: l.sn ≤ l'.sn

rows.sourceStory: **T2.** The epoch changes only under a rotation, and then by one.

story.given:
(p : Params) (env : Env) {a : Action} {t : Slot} {l l' : Live} {f : Flow}
    (h : Step p env a t (.present l) f (.present l')) (hne : l'.epoch ≠ l.epoch)
story.when: Observe the local Checkpoint or associated system relation named by this theorem.
story.then: a.actor = .nextKeys ∧ l'.epoch = l.epoch + 1

rows.sourceStory: **T3a.** A rotation always yields an unpoisoned state.

story.when: Observe the local Checkpoint or associated system relation named by this theorem.
story.then: l'.poisoned = false

rows.sourceStory: **T3b.** Only a rotation clears the poison.

story.when: Observe the local Checkpoint or associated system relation named by this theorem.
story.then: a.actor = .nextKeys

rows.sourceStory:
**T3c.** Only the poison sets it, from a clean state, and it changes
nothing else.

story.when: Observe the local Checkpoint or associated system relation named by this theorem.
story.then: a = .poison ∧ l' = { l with poisoned := true } ∧ f = {}

rows.sourceStory:
The poison bit along a trace from a present state is the fold of the
actions over the starting bit.

story.given:
(p : Params) (env : Env) {t : Slot} {s s' : State}
    {es : List (Slot × Action)} (h : Trace p env t s es s')
story.when: Observe the local Checkpoint or associated system relation named by this theorem.
story.then: ∀ l0 l, s = .present l0 → s' = .present l → l.poisoned = poisonAfter l0.poisoned es

rows.sourceStory:
**T3d.** Along any trace from `absent`, the checkpoint is poisoned
exactly when the last epoch-relevant action was a poison.

story.given:
(p : Params) (env : Env) {t : Slot} {es : List (Slot × Action)} {l : Live}
    (h : Trace p env t .absent es (.present l))
story.when: Observe the local Checkpoint or associated system relation named by this theorem.
story.then: l.poisoned = poisonSinceLastRotation es

rows.sourceStory:
**T4a.** From a poisoned state the current quorum can do nothing, and no
proof can freeze it.

story.when: Observe the local Checkpoint or associated system relation named by this theorem.
story.then: a.actor ≠ .currentQuorum ∧ (∀ sn' payee, a ≠ .freeze sn' payee)

rows.sourceStory:
**T4b.** From a poisoned state, nothing but the next keys yields a
consumable state.

story.when: Observe the local Checkpoint or associated system relation named by this theorem.
story.then: ¬ consumableState p t' s'

rows.statement:
theorem T4_current_quorum_only_poisons (p : Params) (env : Env) {a : Action} {t : Slot} {s s' : State}
    {f : Flow} (h : Step p env a t s f s') (hq : a.actor = .currentQuorum) : a = .poison
rows.sourceStory:
**T4c.** The current keys' only Cardano power is the poison: whatever
the current quorum signs, the step is a poison (D-036).

story.given:
(p : Params) (env : Env) {a : Action} {t : Slot} {s s' : State}
    {f : Flow} (h : Step p env a t s f s') (hq : a.actor = .currentQuorum)
story.when: Observe the local Checkpoint or associated system relation named by this theorem.
story.then: a = .poison

rows.sourceStory:
**T4d.** A thief of the current keys cannot act as the next keys: when
the next keys of the checkpoint's key state never signed a rotation, no
step from that checkpoint is by the next keys and none freezes it —
whatever the current keys sign. What is left is the poison, a top-up and a
conviction.

story.when: Observe the local Checkpoint or associated system relation named by this theorem.
story.then: a.actor ≠ .nextKeys ∧ (∀ sn' payee, a ≠ .freeze sn' payee)

rows.statement:
theorem T5_every_bond_option (p : Params) (env : Env) (t : Slot) (l : Live) (sn' : Seq)
    (payee : Addr) (hev : env.rotationTo l.epoch l.sn sn' = true) (hsn : l.sn < sn') :
    ∀ (op : BondOp) (r' : Option Addr), env.intentOk (l.epoch + 1) op.intent r' = true →
      ∃ (f : Flow) (l' : Live), Step p env (.rotate sn' op payee r') t (.present l) f (.present l')
rows.sourceStory:
**T5a.** Given a valid witnessed rotation and the new keys' signature on
the bond option and the optional new refund address — one message carrying
both (D-038) — both bond options are enabled at every address choice,
whatever the pool holds (payment is never a gate, T14) and whether or not
the checkpoint is frozen. `keep` with no new address needs no signature.

story.given:
(p : Params) (env : Env) (t : Slot) (l : Live) (sn' : Seq)
    (payee : Addr) (hev : env.rotationTo l.epoch l.sn sn' = true) (hsn : l.sn < sn')
story.when: Observe the local Checkpoint or associated system relation named by this theorem.
story.then:
∀ (op : BondOp) (r' : Option Addr), env.intentOk (l.epoch + 1) op.intent r' = true →
      ∃ (f : Flow) (l' : Live), Step p env (.rotate sn' op payee r') t (.present l) f (.present l')

rows.sourceStory:
**T5j.** A keep is exactly the rotated datum with the premium: the flow
is the premium to the payee and nothing else, the state is `Live.rotated`
— which ties the helper the next two statements use to the constructors'
field-by-field conclusions.

story.when: Observe the local Checkpoint or associated system relation named by this theorem.
story.then: f = { hunter := p.premium l payee } ∧ s' = .present (l.rotated p sn' r')

rows.statement:
theorem T5_deposit_on_full_is_keep (p : Params) (env : Env) {t : Slot} {l : Live} {f : Flow}
    {s' : State} {sn' : Seq} {payee : Addr} {r' : Option Addr}
    (hfull : l.frozen = false)
    (hd : Step p env (.rotate sn' .deposit payee r') t (.present l) f s') :
    f = { hunter := p.premium l payee } ∧ f.bIn = 0 ∧ f.dregIn = 0 ∧ f.poolIn = 0 ∧
    s' = .present (l.rotated p sn' r') ∧
    ∃ l', s' = .present l' ∧ l'.bornAt = l.bornAt ∧ l'.frozen = false ∧ l'.sn = sn' ∧
      l'.epoch = l.epoch + 1 ∧ l'.poisoned = false ∧ l'.refundTo = r'.getD l.refundTo ∧
      ((p.P ≤ l.pool ∧ f.hunter = some { addr := payee, pool := p.P } ∧ l'.pool + p.P = l.pool) ∨
       (l.pool < p.P ∧ f.hunter = none ∧ l'.pool = l.pool))
rows.sourceStory:
**T5h.** D-040: a deposit is a no-op on full bonds. Every licensed
deposit from an unfrozen checkpoint is keep-shaped — from the deposit step
alone, whatever else the keys did or did not sign: it brings nothing, pays
the premium as a keep would, leaves the rotated datum with the freeze bit
clear, and resets nothing (`bornAt` unchanged).

story.when: Observe the local Checkpoint or associated system relation named by this theorem.
story.then:
f = { hunter := p.premium l payee } ∧ f.bIn = 0 ∧ f.dregIn = 0 ∧ f.poolIn = 0 ∧
    s' = .present (l.rotated p sn' r') ∧
    ∃ l', s' = .present l' ∧ l'.bornAt = l.bornAt ∧ l'.frozen = false ∧ l'.sn = sn' ∧
      l'.epoch = l.epoch + 1 ∧ l'.poisoned = false ∧ l'.refundTo = r'.getD l.refundTo ∧
      ((p.P ≤ l.pool ∧ f.hunter = some { addr := payee, pool := p.P } ∧ l'.pool + p.P = l.pool) ∨
       (l.pool < p.P ∧ f.hunter = none ∧ l'.pool = l.pool))

rows.statement:
theorem T5_poison_enabled (p : Params) (env : Env) (t : Slot) (l : Live)
    (hq : env.quorum l.epoch = true) (hclean : l.poisoned = false) :
    ∃ l', Step p env .poison t (.present l) {} (.present l')
rows.sourceStory: **T5b.** Given the quorum, an unpoisoned state can be poisoned.

story.given:
(p : Params) (env : Env) (t : Slot) (l : Live)
    (hq : env.quorum l.epoch = true) (hclean : l.poisoned = false)
story.when: Observe the local Checkpoint or associated system relation named by this theorem.
story.then: ∃ l', Step p env .poison t (.present l) {} (.present l')

rows.statement:
theorem T5_freeze_enabled (p : Params) (env : Env) (t : Slot) (l : Live) (sn' : Seq) (payee : Addr)
    (hev : env.rotationTo l.epoch l.sn sn' = true) (hsn : l.sn < sn')
    (hpool : l.pool < p.P) (hb : l.frozen = false) (hclean : l.poisoned = false) :
    ∃ (f : Flow) (l' : Live), Step p env (.freeze sn' payee) t (.present l) f (.present l')
rows.sourceStory:
**T5c.** Given a later witnessed rotation, a short pool, the freeze bond
held and no poison, the freeze is enabled.

story.given:
(p : Params) (env : Env) (t : Slot) (l : Live) (sn' : Seq) (payee : Addr)
    (hev : env.rotationTo l.epoch l.sn sn' = true) (hsn : l.sn < sn')
    (hpool : l.pool < p.P) (hb : l.frozen = false) (hclean : l.poisoned = false)
story.when: Observe the local Checkpoint or associated system relation named by this theorem.
story.then: ∃ (f : Flow) (l' : Live), Step p env (.freeze sn' payee) t (.present l) f (.present l')

rows.statement:
theorem T5_convict_enabled (p : Params) (env : Env) (t : Slot) (l : Live) (payee : Addr)
    (hdup : env.duplicityAt l.epoch l.sn = true) :
    ∃ f, Step p env (.convict payee) t (.present l) f (.terminationPending l.hash)
rows.sourceStory:
Given Every parameter, slot, source state and payee in the exact type; the enabled statements additionally assume concrete duplicity at that source state.
When Execute the local conviction transition, or compare it to its complete guard in the iff statements.
Then The exact existing component flow and concrete duplicity guard remain; the target is pending at the source hash. Both iff directions remain obligations. Enabled clauses are local applicability only, not a claim that an arbitrary economic request can be booked.

story.given:
(p : Params) (env : Env) (t : Slot) (l : Live) (payee : Addr)
    (hdup : env.duplicityAt l.epoch l.sn = true)
story.when: Observe the local Checkpoint or associated system relation named by this theorem.
story.then: ∃ f, Step p env (.convict payee) t (.present l) f (.terminationPending l.hash)

rows.statement:
theorem T5_keep_needs_no_intent (p : Params) (env : Env) (t : Slot) (l : Live) (sn' : Seq) (payee : Addr)
    (hev : env.rotationTo l.epoch l.sn sn' = true) (hsn : l.sn < sn') :
    ∃ (f : Flow) (l' : Live), Step p env (.rotate sn' .keep payee none) t (.present l) f (.present l')
rows.sourceStory:
**T5g.** D-038's empty message: a keep that names no new address needs no
signature at all — given the witnessed rotation it is enabled under every
environment, whatever the new keys did or did not sign.

story.given:
(p : Params) (env : Env) (t : Slot) (l : Live) (sn' : Seq) (payee : Addr)
    (hev : env.rotationTo l.epoch l.sn sn' = true) (hsn : l.sn < sn')
story.when: Observe the local Checkpoint or associated system relation named by this theorem.
story.then: ∃ (f : Flow) (l' : Live), Step p env (.rotate sn' .keep payee none) t (.present l) f (.present l')

rows.statement:
theorem T6_component_conservation (p : Params) (env : Env) {a : Action} {t : Slot} {s s' : State} {f : Flow}
    (h : Step p env a t s f s') :
    s.dregHeld p + f.dregIn = s'.dregHeld p + Payment?.dreg f.refund + Payment?.dreg f.hunter + Payment?.dreg f.convictor ∧
    s.bHeld p + f.bIn = s'.bHeld p + Payment?.b f.refund + Payment?.b f.hunter + Payment?.b f.convictor ∧
    s.poolHeld + f.poolIn = s'.poolHeld + Payment?.pool f.refund + Payment?.pool f.hunter + Payment?.pool f.convictor
rows.sourceStory:
Given Every successful Step over arbitrary states, actions, time, environment and Params.
When Observe before/after holdings and addressed flow.
Then Each of D, B and pool satisfies its own full incoming = retained + refund + hunter + convictor equality. No component is used as an undeclared min-ADA or fee source.

story.given:
(p : Params) (env : Env) {a : Action} {t : Slot} {s s' : State} {f : Flow}
    (h : Step p env a t s f s')
story.when: Observe the local Checkpoint or associated system relation named by this theorem.
story.then:
s.dregHeld p + f.dregIn = s'.dregHeld p + Payment?.dreg f.refund + Payment?.dreg f.hunter + Payment?.dreg f.convictor ∧
    s.bHeld p + f.bIn = s'.bHeld p + Payment?.b f.refund + Payment?.b f.hunter + Payment?.b f.convictor ∧
    s.poolHeld + f.poolIn = s'.poolHeld + Payment?.pool f.refund + Payment?.pool f.hunter + Payment?.pool f.convictor

rows.statement:
theorem T6_dreg_never_a_fee (p : Params) (env : Env) {a : Action} {t : Slot} {s s' : State} {f : Flow}
    (h : Step p env a t s f s') :
    Payment?.dreg f.hunter = 0 ∧
    (Payment?.dreg f.refund ≠ 0 → Payment?.dreg f.refund = p.D ∧ s.dregHeld p = p.D ∧ s'.dregHeld p = 0) ∧
    (Payment?.dreg f.convictor ≠ 0 → Payment?.dreg f.convictor = p.D ∧ s.dregHeld p = p.D ∧ ∃ l, s = .present l ∧ s' = .terminationPending l.hash)
rows.sourceStory:
Given Every parameter/environment/action/time/state/flow and an actual local Step.
When Inspect D payments to hunter, refund and convictor.
Then Hunter receives zero D; every nonzero refund is exactly D from a D-holding source to a zero-D successor; every nonzero convictor payment is exactly D from a D-holding live source, and the target is pending at that same source hash. All original amount/source/non-fee clauses remain.

story.given:
(p : Params) (env : Env) {a : Action} {t : Slot} {s s' : State} {f : Flow}
    (h : Step p env a t s f s')
story.when: Observe the local Checkpoint or associated system relation named by this theorem.
story.then:
Payment?.dreg f.hunter = 0 ∧
    (Payment?.dreg f.refund ≠ 0 → Payment?.dreg f.refund = p.D ∧ s.dregHeld p = p.D ∧ s'.dregHeld p = 0) ∧
    (Payment?.dreg f.convictor ≠ 0 → Payment?.dreg f.convictor = p.D ∧ s.dregHeld p = p.D ∧ ∃ l, s = .present l ∧ s' = .terminationPending l.hash)

rows.sourceStory:
**T6h.** No unbonded on-chain state (D-040): between present states the
conviction bond neither enters nor leaves — a present checkpoint holds it
in full before and after every step that keeps the UTxO.

story.given:
(p : Params) (env : Env) {a : Action} {t : Slot}
    {l l' : Live} {f : Flow} (h : Step p env a t (.present l) f (.present l'))
story.when: Observe the local Checkpoint or associated system relation named by this theorem.
story.then: f.dregIn = 0 ∧ Payment?.dreg f.refund = 0 ∧ Payment?.dreg f.hunter = 0 ∧ Payment?.dreg f.convictor = 0

rows.statement:
theorem T6_dreg_enters_only_at_birth (p : Params) (env : Env) {a : Action} {t : Slot} {s s' : State} {f : Flow}
    (h : Step p env a t s f s') (hin : f.dregIn ≠ 0) :
    (∃ refund pool0, a = .register refund pool0 ∧ s = .absent) ∧
    f.dregIn = p.D ∧ f.bIn = p.B ∧ ∃ l', s' = .present l' ∧ l'.frozen = false ∧ l'.bornAt = t
rows.sourceStory:
**T6c.** The conviction bond enters only at the birth, the registration,
and then in full, together with the freeze bond.

story.given:
(p : Params) (env : Env) {a : Action} {t : Slot} {s s' : State} {f : Flow}
    (h : Step p env a t s f s') (hin : f.dregIn ≠ 0)
story.when: Observe the local Checkpoint or associated system relation named by this theorem.
story.then:
(∃ refund pool0, a = .register refund pool0 ∧ s = .absent) ∧
    f.dregIn = p.D ∧ f.bIn = p.B ∧ ∃ l', s' = .present l' ∧ l'.frozen = false ∧ l'.bornAt = t

rows.statement:
theorem T6_refund_change_requires_new_keys (p : Params) (env : Env) {a : Action} {t : Slot} {l l' : Live} {f : Flow}
    (h : Step p env a t (.present l) f (.present l')) (hne : l'.refundTo ≠ l.refundTo) :
    ∃ sn' op payee, a = .rotate sn' op payee (some l'.refundTo) ∧
      env.intentAuthorized l'.epoch op.intent (some l'.refundTo) = true
rows.sourceStory:
**T6d.** `refundTo` changes only under a rotation that names the new
address, and the message the new keys signed is that rotation's own option
with that address (D-032, D-038): no unrelated intent authorizes the move.

story.given:
(p : Params) (env : Env) {a : Action} {t : Slot} {l l' : Live} {f : Flow}
    (h : Step p env a t (.present l) f (.present l')) (hne : l'.refundTo ≠ l.refundTo)
story.when: Observe the local Checkpoint or associated system relation named by this theorem.
story.then:
∃ sn' op payee, a = .rotate sn' op payee (some l'.refundTo) ∧
      env.intentAuthorized l'.epoch op.intent (some l'.refundTo) = true

rows.sourceStory:
**T6e.** The freeze bond moves between present states only by a rotation
(the deposit) or a freeze; poison and top-up move no bond.

story.when: Observe the local Checkpoint or associated system relation named by this theorem.
story.then: a.actor = .nextKeys ∨ (∃ sn' payee, a = .freeze sn' payee)

rows.statement:
theorem T6_intent_requires_new_keys (p : Params) (env : Env) {t : Slot} {l : Live} {f : Flow} {s' : State} :
    (∀ {sn' payee r'}, Step p env (.rotate sn' .deposit payee r') t (.present l) f s' →
      env.intentAuthorized (l.epoch + 1) .deposit r' = true) ∧
    (∀ {sn' payee r}, Step p env (.rotate sn' .keep payee (some r)) t (.present l) f s' →
      env.intentAuthorized (l.epoch + 1) .keep (some r) = true)
rows.sourceStory:
**T6f.** Every intent other than the empty one is authorized by the keys
of the epoch the rotation opens (D-038): a deposit and a keep with a new
address each carry the new keys' signature on that intent and that
address. A relayer with public data alone can land a keep and nothing else.

story.given: (p : Params) (env : Env) {t : Slot} {l : Live} {f : Flow} {s' : State}
story.when: Observe the local Checkpoint or associated system relation named by this theorem.
story.then:
(∀ {sn' payee r'}, Step p env (.rotate sn' .deposit payee r') t (.present l) f s' →
      env.intentAuthorized (l.epoch + 1) .deposit r' = true) ∧
    (∀ {sn' payee r}, Step p env (.rotate sn' .keep payee (some r)) t (.present l) f s' →
      env.intentAuthorized (l.epoch + 1) .keep (some r) = true)

rows.statement:
theorem T6_relayer_cannot_park_age_or_close (p : Params) (env : Env) {a : Action} {t : Slot} {l : Live}
    {f : Flow} {s' : State} (h : Step p env a t (.present l) f s')
    (hno : ∀ i r, env.intentAuthorized (l.epoch + 1) i r = false) (hact : a.actor = .nextKeys) :
    ∃ sn' payee, a = .rotate sn' .keep payee none
rows.sourceStory:
**T6g.** Without the new keys' signature nothing but a keep with the
address unchanged lands: if the keys of epoch `e + 1` authorized no intent
at all, every next-keys step from epoch `e` is a keep with `refund' = none` —
a relayer cannot unfreeze or move the address. (There is no owner close to
make; the name is kept as the statement's identity.)

story.when: Observe the local Checkpoint or associated system relation named by this theorem.
story.then: ∃ sn' payee, a = .rotate sn' .keep payee none

rows.statement:
theorem T7_step_iff_stepFn (p : Params) (env : Env) {a : Action} {t : Slot} {s s' : State} {f : Flow} :
    Step p env a t s f s' ↔ stepFn p env a t s = some (f, s')
rows.sourceStory:
Given All p/env/actions/times/states/flows/successors without additional reachability assumptions.
When Compare Step with executable stepFn.
Then Step holds iff stepFn returns precisely some(flow,successor), in both directions.

story.given: (p : Params) (env : Env) {a : Action} {t : Slot} {s s' : State} {f : Flow}
story.when: Observe the local Checkpoint or associated system relation named by this theorem.
story.then: Step p env a t s f s' ↔ stepFn p env a t s = some (f, s')

rows.statement:
theorem T7_trace_iff_replay (p : Params) (env : Env) {t : Slot} {s s' : State} {es : List (Slot × Action)} :
    Trace p env t s es s' ↔ replay p env t s es = some s'
rows.sourceStory:
Given All p/env/start-time/states and timestamped action lists.
When Compare Trace with replay.
Then Trace holds iff replay returns precisely the stated final state; timestamp and refusal semantics unchanged.

story.given: (p : Params) (env : Env) {t : Slot} {s s' : State} {es : List (Slot × Action)}
story.when: Observe the local Checkpoint or associated system relation named by this theorem.
story.then: Trace p env t s es s' ↔ replay p env t s es = some s'

rows.statement:
theorem T8_leaf_agrees_with_state (p : Params) (env : Env) {s : Sys} (h : SysReach p env s) (aid : AID) :
    s.leaves aid = (s.states aid).leaf
rows.sourceStory:
**T8a.** In every reachable system every leaf agrees with its state:
the leaf is exactly the identity-level projection of the UTxO's state.

story.given: (p : Params) (env : Env) {s : Sys} (h : SysReach p env s) (aid : AID)
story.when: Observe the local Checkpoint or associated system relation named by this theorem.
story.then: s.leaves aid = (s.states aid).leaf

rows.sourceStory:
Given Arbitrary reachable Checkpoint Sys and a successful local Step on the chosen AID with every typed parameter.
When Apply Sys.set to that local result.
Then The entire leaf function is unchanged iff Action.touchesLeaf is false. Only local registration has touchesLeaf=true; conviction-to-pending is false. Completed retirement is a separate associated system event, not a local Action.

story.given:
(p : Params) (env : Env) {s : Sys} {aid : AID} {a : Action} {now : Slot}
    {f : Flow} {st' : State} (hs : SysReach p env s) (hstep : Step p env a now (s.states aid) f st')
story.when: Observe the local Checkpoint or associated system relation named by this theorem.
story.then: (s.set aid st').leaves = s.leaves ↔ a.touchesLeaf = false

rows.statement:
theorem T8_present_implies_registered (p : Params) (env : Env) {s : Sys} (h : SysReach p env s)
    (aid : AID) (hne : s.states aid ≠ .absent) : s.leaves aid ≠ .absent
rows.sourceStory:
**T8c.** In every reachable system, an AID with a state other than
`absent` has a leaf: active or retired — the token was minted once
by a registration under an absence proof and the leaf never returns to
absent.

story.given:
(p : Params) (env : Env) {s : Sys} (h : SysReach p env s)

Given every successful step over arbitrary parameters, environment, action,
time and states.
When the held amounts before and after and the step's flow are compared.
Then what the input holds plus what the step takes in equals what the output
holds plus what the step pays out.

(p : Params) (env : Env) {a : Action} {t : Slot}

story.then: s.heldAmounts p + f.takenIn = s'.heldAmounts p + f.paidOut

rows.statement:
theorem conviction_pays_out_every_amount (p : Params) (env : Env) {t : Slot} {l : Live}
    {payee : Addr} {f : Flow} {s' : State} (h : Step p env (.convict payee) t (.present l) f s') :
    Payment?.total f.convictor = p.D ∧
    Payment?.total f.refund = l.bHeld p + l.pool ∧
    Payment?.total f.hunter = 0 ∧
    s'.heldAmounts p = 0 ∧
    f.paidOut = (State.present l).heldAmounts p
rows.sourceStory:
Given a live checkpoint convicted to its pending termination.
When the step's payments are compared with what the live checkpoint held.
Then the convictor receives exactly the deposit, the refund address exactly the
freeze bond held and the pool, and the pending output keeps none of them.

story.given:
(p : Params) (env : Env) {t : Slot} {l : Live}
    {payee : Addr} {f : Flow} {s' : State} (h : Step p env (.convict payee) t (.present l) f s')

    Payment?.total f.refund = l.bHeld p + l.pool ∧
    Payment?.total f.hunter = 0 ∧
    s'.heldAmounts p = 0 ∧
    f.paidOut = (State.present l).heldAmounts p

rows.statement:
theorem short_holding_refused (i : Interpretation) (c : Context) (p : Params)
    (rp : CardanoKeri.Registry.Params) (s : State) (o : AH.ObservedOutput)
    (short : o.lovelace < s.valueFloor p rp) : ¬ realizesState i c p rp s o
rows.sourceStory:
Given any interpretation, context and parameters, and a holding whose lovelace
is below the floor of a state: the minimum ADA plus the deposit plus the freeze
bond a live state's datum says is held, or the minimum ADA of a pending one.
When it is checked against that state.
Then it does not realize it, whatever its pool: a holding missing part of a bond
is refused.

story.given:
(i : Interpretation) (c : Context) (p : Params)

    createRegistry i c abstractRegistry q.configuration commit q.genesisTx q.genesisOutputs = .ok r.created ∧

      r.booked.config.applicationPolicy q.unspent q.economicTx = .ok (r.foldFlow, r.after) ∧
    SingularApplicationHeld.fold .none i.hash i.code commit c.release q.fullFold = true ∧

      some (r.checkpointFlow, r.checkpoint) ∧

    ∃ receipt : CardanoKeri.Registry.FoldReceipt q.registryParams q.registryEnv q.configuration,
      receipt.before = r.booked ∧ receipt.after = r.after ∧

theorem convictCkpt_iff (env : Env) (s s' : Sys) (aid : Nat) (f : Flow) :
    convictCkpt env s aid = .ok (f, s') ↔
      ∃ c, carrierAt s aid = some c ∧
        c.st = .live ∧ env.duplicity aid c.k = true ∧
        f = {} ∧ s' = { s with carriers := s.carriers.map (fun old =>
          if old.aid == aid then { old with st := .terminationPending } else old) }
rows.sourceStory:

retention theorems; when one of the actual local functions succeeds; then
all source/guard/exact-flow/successor clauses in its iff hold in both
directions, and every stated actual-world, metadata, counter, other-AID,
key/alias/holding/min-ADA clause holds. Conviction preserves the key. Registry's empty internal conviction
flow is scoped to its coarse transport, not denial of Checkpoint's addressed
payments. Two-AID reachable witnesses and single-field key/token/Mc/frame
mutations are required. A fallback minAdaAt=0 alone is never the success
witness. No same-token claim is based only on token count.

theorem bookTermination_iff (p : Params) (s s' : Sys) (aid booker fee : Nat)
    (b : Singular.TerminationBooking) (f : Flow) :
    bookTermination p s aid booker fee b = .ok (f, s') ↔
      ∃ c world, carrierAt s aid = some c ∧ c.st = .terminationPending ∧
        b.request.key = aid ∧ b.request.destination = c.original.output ∧
        b.custodyInputs = [c.original] ∧ c.minAda = p.Mc ∧
        b.request.carrierAda = p.Mr ∧ b.request.declaredTip = p.tip ∧
        b.request.contents.lovelace = p.Mr + p.tip ∧
        Singular.bookTermination s.toWorld b = .ok world ∧
        s' = { s with
          carriers := s.carriers.filter (fun old => old.aid != aid),
          terminations := { booking := b, payload := {
            aid := aid, token := c.token, keyState := c.k, original := c.original,
            booker := booker, bookingFee := fee } } :: s.terminations } ∧
        s'.toWorld = world ∧
        f = {
          premium := some (booker, p.Mc - p.Mr - p.tip),
          bookingFee := fee, intoRequest := p.Mr + p.tip }
rows.sourceStory:
Given the exact inputs and actual success, plus actual Reach history where
stated; when booking the convicted carrier or inspecting a reachable pending
record; then the iff includes every application field constraint, actual
imported admission and complete successor, premium, request and external fee
observation. Each reachable booked payload has a real prior reachable KERI
conviction at its retained key, using the existing opaque premise. This is
not a proof that the opaque predicate equals concrete Checkpoint duplicity.
All earlier pending records survive wholly; actual supply remains one and
custody moves exactly once. Required refusals: live without prior
conviction, invalid coarse proof, wrong holding/key/token, duplicate reference
in either store, second booking of the same carrier, and a tail-drop mutant
that otherwise still admits both bookings. Full concrete Checkpoint evidence
controls are exercised separately from the whole-record preservation claim.

      ∃ c world, carrierAt s aid = some c ∧ c.st = .terminationPending ∧
        b.request.key = aid ∧ b.request.destination = c.original.output ∧
        b.custodyInputs = [c.original] ∧ c.minAda = p.Mc ∧
        b.request.carrierAda = p.Mr ∧ b.request.declaredTip = p.tip ∧
        b.request.contents.lovelace = p.Mr + p.tip ∧
        Singular.bookTermination s.toWorld b = .ok world ∧

          bookingFee := fee, intoRequest := p.Mr + p.tip }

    (gen plugin : Nat) (u : Singular.EconomicUtxo) (tx : Singular.EconomicTransaction)
    (b : Singular.RegistrationBooking)
    (selected : Singular.FoldMember.registration b ∈ Singular.foldMembers s.toWorld tx)
    (known : Singular.trieGet s.trie b.request.key = .known .active ∨
      Singular.trieGet s.trie b.request.key = .known .terminal) :
    (fold p env s gen plugin u tx).toOption = none
rows.sourceStory:
Given an actual selected registration for an already active/terminal key, or
an actual pending termination in a reachable canonical Sys; when the supplied
actual transaction attempts registration/retraction/rejection as specified;
then the adapter refuses. Known-key refusal preserves the arbitrary-input
scope of the old registration refusal. Termination recovery refusal uses the
actual admitted request kind and current reachable custody, not now<far or
synthetic go-request timestamps. These are current source-bound generic
protection clauses; they do not establish all application recovery guarantees
in #468. A valid unrelated registration recovery and actual proper terminating
fold are required positive companions.

    (known : Singular.trieGet s.trie b.request.key = .known .active ∨
      Singular.trieGet s.trie b.request.key = .known .terminal)

story.then: (fold p env s gen plugin u tx).toOption = none

    ∃ registered pending booked retired,
      ∃ (b : Singular.TerminationBooking) (u : Singular.EconomicUtxo)
        (tx : Singular.EconomicTransaction) (f : Flow),
      RegistrationJourney registered ∧
      convictCkpt env registered 11 = .ok ({}, pending) ∧
      carrierAt pending 11 = some { liveCarrier with st := .terminationPending } ∧
      Singular.trieGet pending.trie 11 = .known .active ∧
      b.request.reference = ⟨200, 0⟩ ∧
      bookTermination p pending 11 7 1 b =
        .ok ({ premium := some (7, 1), intoRequest := 3, bookingFee := 1 }, booked) ∧
      Singular.worldSingularSupply booked.toWorld 11 = 1 ∧
      fold p env booked booked.gen cfg.applicationPolicy u tx = .ok (f, retired) ∧
      Singular.trieGet retired.trie 11 = .known .terminal ∧
      Singular.worldSingularSupply retired.toWorld 11 = 0 ∧
      tx.transaction.donation = 2 ∧ Singular.foldCarrierLovelace tx.outputs = 0 ∧
      pendingAt retired ⟨200, 0⟩ = none

clause, when an arbitrary adapter step succeeds, then the
entire invariant persists. Reachable initial/step history supplies this
predicate and the explicit domain iff; generic reachability alone does not
prove anything about alias bindings. The empty-world/phantom-alias
fixture must fail bindingDomain, while a genuine fresh registration succeeds.
No policy rejects legitimate registration merely to avoid that missing proof.

competing action, and absence of consumption of its exact reference; when
observing its successor; then the complete old record, token binding, active
leaf and supply remain. This covers local steps, booking in either store,
generic recovery and mixed fold. No obsolete now<far premise is imported.
These are the successors to Agreement's
custody and refusal obligations, not merely names for the old go-request.

rows.statement:
theorem reap_conserves (r : Reap) :
    (reap r).intoRequest + (reap r).premium = r.Mc
rows.sourceStory:
Given every nonnegative amount in Reap and its funding inequality; when
convicted-carrier booking splits Mc; then request plus premium equals Mc.
The fee is an explicit external payment, not deducted from a bond or added
to this equation. This preserves the old exact theorem, with its domain
corrected from parked-or-convicted to convicted only. Witness Mc4/Mr2/tip1:
request3 plus premium1. This does not assert a real booking succeeds.

story.given: (r : Reap)
story.when: Observe the booking split or accepted fold accounting named by this theorem.
story.then: (reap r).intoRequest + (reap r).premium = r.Mc

rows.statement:
theorem booking_premium_exact (r : Reap) :
    (reap r).premium + r.Mr + r.tip = r.Mc
rows.sourceStory:
Given all Reap fields and its funding inequality; when comparing the booked
premium with the external booking fee; then the exact recovery equation,
both directions of the non-loss condition, and strict-loss implication hold.
These statements do not treat outside fold input returned as a request
refund. Counterexample to the retired old condition: Mc4/Mr2/tip1/fee2
satisfies old tip+fee≤Mc, but premium1<fee2. Positive companion: fee1.

rows.statement:
theorem imported_fold_accounting
    (world after : Singular.World) (reachable : Singular.WorldReachable world)
    (unspent : Singular.EconomicUtxo) (tx : Singular.EconomicTransaction)
    (accepted : fold world unspent tx = .ok after) :
    Singular.balanced unspent.ledger tx.transaction = true ∧
    Singular.foldStateLovelace (Singular.economicSpent unspent tx) =
      Singular.foldStateLovelace tx.outputs ∧
    tx.transaction.donation =
      (Singular.foldObligations (Singular.foldMembers world tx)).donation ∧
    Singular.foldCarrierLovelace tx.outputs =
      (Singular.foldObligations (Singular.foldMembers world tx)).carriers ∧
    Singular.foldOrdinaryLovelace tx.outputs + tx.transaction.fee =
      Singular.foldOrdinaryLovelace (Singular.economicSpent unspent tx) +
        (Singular.foldObligations (Singular.foldMembers world tx)).tips ∧
    tx.transaction.fee ≤
      Singular.foldOrdinaryLovelace (Singular.economicSpent unspent tx) ∧
    after.treasury = world.treasury + tx.transaction.donation ∧
    Singular.requestTagsBurned unspent tx = true
rows.sourceStory:
Given all actual execution premises above, with no restriction on member
kinds; when reading an accepted fold; then all eight upstream accounting
clauses hold by `fold_routes_every_amount` through the definition of fold.
`Registry.current_sys_fold_accounting` instantiates the actual Sys projection
and executed transition. `RegistryJourneyChecks` mixes a registration with
a termination while retaining another whole pending termination. Donation, carrier, tip and state-value mutations have separate
observations, rather than relying on one broad accounting failure.

    (accepted : fold world unspent tx = .ok after)
story.when: Observe the booking split or accepted fold accounting named by this theorem.
story.then:
Singular.balanced unspent.ledger tx.transaction = true ∧
    Singular.foldStateLovelace (Singular.economicSpent unspent tx) =
      Singular.foldStateLovelace tx.outputs ∧
    tx.transaction.donation =
      (Singular.foldObligations (Singular.foldMembers world tx)).donation ∧
    Singular.foldCarrierLovelace tx.outputs =
      (Singular.foldObligations (Singular.foldMembers world tx)).carriers ∧
    Singular.foldOrdinaryLovelace tx.outputs + tx.transaction.fee =
      Singular.foldOrdinaryLovelace (Singular.economicSpent unspent tx) +
        (Singular.foldObligations (Singular.foldMembers world tx)).tips ∧
    tx.transaction.fee ≤
      Singular.foldOrdinaryLovelace (Singular.economicSpent unspent tx) ∧
    after.treasury = world.treasury + tx.transaction.donation ∧
    Singular.requestTagsBurned unspent tx = true

theorem termination_fold_accounting
    (r : Reap) (world after : Singular.World)
    (reachable : Singular.WorldReachable world)
    (unspent : Singular.EconomicUtxo) (tx : Singular.EconomicTransaction)
    (b : Singular.TerminationBooking)
    (matched : MatchesBooking r b)
    (members : Singular.foldMembers world tx = [.termination b])
    (accepted : fold world unspent tx = .ok after) :
    tx.transaction.donation = r.Mr ∧
    Singular.foldCarrierLovelace tx.outputs = 0 ∧
    Singular.foldOrdinaryLovelace tx.outputs + tx.transaction.fee =
      Singular.foldOrdinaryLovelace (Singular.economicSpent unspent tx) + r.tip ∧
    tx.transaction.fee ≤
      Singular.foldOrdinaryLovelace (Singular.economicSpent unspent tx) ∧
    after.treasury = world.treasury + r.Mr ∧
    Singular.balanced unspent.ledger tx.transaction = true ∧
    Singular.requestTagsBurned unspent tx = true
rows.sourceStory:
Given a reachable actual World, actual unspent set/transaction, the single
selected booked termination matching the application split, and successful
actual fold; when reading outputs, fee, donation, tags and treasury; then
all seven clauses hold. No owner refund or named folder recipient follows.
`Registry.Examples.W5_connected_termination` starts with actual registration
and authorized application conviction. `RegistryJourneyChecks` checks wrong
donation and balanced old-refund refusals against successful actual folds.

rows.statement:
theorem self_fold_addressed_accounting
    (r : Reap) (world after : Singular.World)
    (reachable : Singular.WorldReachable world)
    (unspent : Singular.EconomicUtxo) (tx : Singular.EconomicTransaction)
    (b : Singular.TerminationBooking) (booker : Nat)
    (matched : MatchesBooking r b)
    (members : Singular.foldMembers world tx = [.termination b])
    (accepted : fold world unspent tx = .ok after)
    (inputsAt : AllOrdinaryAt booker (Singular.economicSpent unspent tx))
    (outputsAt : AllOrdinaryAt booker tx.outputs) :
    ordinaryAt booker tx.outputs + tx.transaction.fee =
      ordinaryAt booker (Singular.economicSpent unspent tx) + r.tip
rows.sourceStory:
Given a reachable World, actual unspent set and accepted fold, exactly one
termination member matching the Reap split, and all ordinary spent/output value at the
specified booker address; when comparing that address's ordinary outflow and
inflow plus its booking premium; then the exact tip/fee equation and both
directions of the non-loss criterion hold. The spent ordinary principal is
on the cost side; returning it is not profit. An address observation is not
a cryptographic ownership proof. A named funding party's authority and
available real funds remain outside this model. Positive model witness must
construct ordinary input and change at the same address. A split-recipient
accepted transaction is a negative control for the allocation premise, not
an assertion that the generic fold refuses other payees.
